markdown.markdown:
::: {.hero} ![Muhammad Suraj Salihu](images/me.jpg){.profile-photo} ### Medical student exploring the intersection of medicine, bioinformatics and computational biology. I am building my skills in **bioinformatics, Python, Linux, Bash scripting, data analysis and reproducible computational workflows**. My goal is to use computational approaches to investigate biological and clinical questions. [Explore My Projects](projects.qmd){.btn .btn-primary} [View My GitHub](https://github.com/MuhammadSurajDuwa){.btn .btn-outline-secondary} ::: --- ## Welcome This website is my **bioinformatics portfolio and learning journal**. I am documenting the projects I build, the tools I learn, the problems I encounter and the progress I make along the way. Rather than allowing a course to end when the lectures finish, I want to continue putting what I learn into practice. --- ## What I'm Learning
::: {.skill-card} ### 🧬 Bioinformatics Sequence analysis, biological databases, conservation analysis and computational biology workflows. ::: ::: {.skill-card} ### Python Python programming for data analysis, automation and bioinformatics. ::: ::: {.skill-card} ### Linux & Bash Command-line tools, shell scripting and reproducible workflows. ::: ::: {.skill-card} ### 📊 Data Analysis Working with biological datasets, visualization and exploratory analysis. ::: ::: {.skill-card} ### Git & GitHub Version control, project organization and collaborative development. ::: ::: {.skill-card} ### 📖 Quarto Creating reproducible reports, documentation and computational websites. :::
--- ## Featured Project. ### FLT3-Conserve A bioinformatics project to explore sequence conservation across species using Python and biological sequence analysis, with a focus on the **FLT3 gene**. This is a project-based learning journey, but I exlore my research interest through it. **Status:** In progress ## My Learning Philosophy > **Learn it. Build it. Document it. Share it.** Every new concept becomes more valuable when I actually use it. This website will grow alongside my skills InshaAllah. --- ## Acknowledgements I am grateful to the **Centre for Biotechnology Research (CBR), Bayero University Kano**, and the tutors who have encouraged me to keep learning and putting these skills into practice. **Alhamdulillah for a beginning as fun as this** *30 August 2026*
